usedFor: Mailparser turns emails into structured data, and Google Drive receives files through “Upload Files” for each parsed email.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Upload Files” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each parsed email can file its attachment in Drive, since the action uploads files from URLs.

watchOut: “Upload Files” in Google Drive takes URLs, so the parsed email must expose a link to each file.
